context_purpose: Apply a fee waiver and priority rule to tenants currently covered by a protection order.

norm_violation_today.reason: Customer-service staff and a ticket system receive the full order and ID images when only a current-coverage fact is needed.

purpose_sufficiency.lost: Case details and order terms, which the benefit rule does not use.

transmission_check.reason: The applicant volunteers documents for a discretionary platform benefit and no statute is known to require copies.

context_purpose: Confirm that a claimant is an entitled heir and that the presenter is her authorised agent before releasing estate funds.

norm_violation_today.reason: The agent (a relative) holds the whole family chart, which exceeds what an agent acting for one heir needs.

purpose_sufficiency.lost: The bank cannot cross-check all heirs or detect competing claims or total share allocation from a single-heir proof.

transmission_check.reason: Banks and estate procedures as I know them require the inheritance documents and authenticated power of attorney on file.

context_purpose: Check that a patron has no overdue or lost items before granting study-room booking and points.

norm_violation_today.reason: The library is the record holder and entitled to the lending data, though a clerk browsing titles is excessive internal access rather than a flow norm breach.

purpose_sufficiency.lost: Nothing material; a good-standing flag covers the decision.

transmission_check.reason: Enrolment in an optional programme, and a server-side yes/no would satisfy it without ZK.

context_purpose: Pay estate funds in staged slices to entitled heirs while keeping an auditable record of the payout basis.

norm_violation_today.reason: Keeping full family charts in every claimant file may exceed need, but the institution may be required to keep the supporting documents.

purpose_sufficiency.lost: Auditors and courts may need the original documents, which a stored proof cannot replace.

transmission_check.reason: Recordkeeping duties likely require evidence on file; whether a proof satisfies them is a regulator question I cannot settle.

context_purpose: Direct guests to the correct bathing area and apply the venue's tattoo age policy.

norm_violation_today.reason: Showing full ID in a public queue exposes name, ID number and birth date to staff and bystanders when only area and pass/fail are needed.

purpose_sufficiency.lost: Staff cannot spot a borrowed or mismatched credential without a photo check, and the predicate as stated is odd and unclear.

transmission_check.reason: The check is a venue policy with no known legal duty to copy ID.

context_purpose: A volunteer co-op confirms a new member has no overdue or lost library items.

norm_violation_today.reason: A printout of the account page gives a volunteer loans, holds and reading history when only good standing is needed.

purpose_sufficiency.lost: Nothing material; the co-op only needs a standing result.

transmission_check.reason: Membership is voluntary and the co-op has no legal duty to see the account page.
